scope: Historical completion and server dependency sets: 3131/3758 C/header paths,107/127 textual done-member lines. Manual classification found no external completion counter accesses in those sets beyond completion.c/completion.h; Rust test direct accesses separately reviewed as quiescent.
disposition: RUSIX_COMPLETION_RUST excludes each driver family (=n, including module exclusion) and MODULES. These plain counter reads do not have a demonstrated completion-lock synchronization proof against Rust stores.
limitations: Textual inventory is not a whole-tree semantic proof. Dependency sets conservatively include cached/host command records. Input metadata distinguishes built source from later scanned source. No alias/type/macro or indirect bytewise proof; initialization/reset still require caller quiescence.
reproduce: python3 audit.py --repo <kernel-checkout> --output-root <linux-out> --write-dir <new-directory>; source commit defaults to the recorded scan; historical .cmd caches must exist.
